answer_1.quote: We assess SLM performance using both automatic metrics and human evaluations of perceived empathy.
answer_1.outputs: empathetic responses to PTSD-related user inputs

answer_2.quote: we use both reference-based and reference-free automatic metrics, including BERTScore , ROUGE-L , METEOR , Distinct-1/2 , and cosine similarity using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation (N=116) to directly assess empathetic quality ... Participants rated perceived empathy on a 5-point Likert scale for each generated response
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated perceived empathy on a 5-point Likert scale and provided a rank ordering of the five responses
